description_en: Queries accelerated domain names that have specified features configured and the status of the domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnUserDomainsByFunc查询用户名下配置了指定功能的所有的域名及其状态
name: DescribeCdnUserDomainsByFunc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the feature.

For example, the ID of the origin host feature (set_req_host_header) is 18
parameters.help_zh:
功能ID，您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html文档，根据功能名称搜索查询。
例如：配置回源HOST（set_req_host_header）功能ID为18
parameters.name: func_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh:
页码，默认值：1。

取值范围：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of domain names to return on each page. Default value: 20.

Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh:
单页显示域名的数量，默认值：20。

取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

PageData.description_en: The configurations of the accelerated domain name
PageData.description_zh: 加速域名的配置数据列表

CdnType.description_en:
The type of workload accelerated by Alibaba Cloud CDN. Valid values:

web: image and small file distribution
download: large file distribution
video: on-demand video and audio streaming
liveStream: live streaming
CdnType.description_zh:
加速业务类型。取值：
web：图片小文件加速。
download：大文件下载加速。
video：视音频点播加速。
liveStream：直播流媒体加速

Cname.description_en: The CNAME assigned to the accelerated domain name

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

online: The domain name is enabled.
offline: The domain is disabled.
configuring: The endpoint group is being configured.
configure_failed: The domain failed to be configured.
checking: The domain name is under review.
check_failed: The domain name failed the review.
stopping: The domain name is be disabled.
deleting: being deleted
DomainStatus.description_zh:
加速域名状态。取值：

online：启用。
offline：停用。
configuring：配置中。
configure_failed：配置失败。
checking：正在审核。
check_failed：审核失败。
stopping：停用中。
deleting：删除中

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the accelerated domain name was added to Alibaba Cloud CDN

GmtModified.description_en: The last time when the accelerated domain was modified

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Source.description_en: The information about the origin server

Content.description_en: The address of the origin server

Port.description_en: The port of the origin server

Priority.description_en: The priority of the configuration item

Type.description_en: The type of the origin server
Type.description_zh:
源站类型。取值：

ipaddr：IP源站。
domain：域名源站。
oss：OSS Bucket为源站。
fc_domain：函数计算为源站

Weight.description_en: The weight of the origin server if multiple origin servers have been specified

SslProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTPS is enabled. Valid values:

on
off
SslProtocol.description_zh:
https开关。取值：
on：已开启。
off：未开启

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
